original_hypothesis: the relational-constraint / sheaf carrier (a family of local sections on overlapping patches of a variable set, with restriction maps, whose native law is GLUING along overlaps) is NOT a new structural domain: its glued answers are exactly those of (a) a D2 constraint/table memory parent that materializes the global answer table by enumerating the whole d^n assignment space and (b) a D4/D5 program-search parent that searches assignments in lex order with an edge verifier, because all three compute the lexicographically least global section of the same cover. The carrier's only advantage is a COST POSITION and not an answer: it is the unique row whose description AND serve are both linear in the number of patches, where the table parent's construction is d^n and the search parent's serve is geometric in the patch count whenever failure is late in the cover

strongest_mundane_explanation: all three admissible rows compute the lex-least solution of the same chain-structured constraint network, so no 'domain difference' can show up in the answers at all; the sheaf's forward and backward passes are dynamic programming, the table parent is that same computation done eagerly by brute force, and the search parent is it done lazily with no lookahead. Every number in this record is therefore a cost comparison between three evaluation orders of one relation, and the candidate's apparent niche is nothing more than 'dynamic programming beats both brute force and naive backtracking', a fact of algorithms rather than of cognitive carriers
strongest_parent_explanation: theory core L4 (compile amortization) on a new coordinate: the table parent is the EAGER materialization and the search parent the LAZY one, exactly as RV-377-044 found for DC1's hypervector against the exemplar store; the sheaf is the intermediate compile point that keeps both coordinates polynomial. The classical parent is bounded-treewidth constraint propagation (D4 kingdom K4.4 plus D5): a chain CSP is solvable by path consistency in O(n d^2), which is precisely the candidate's serve law, so the literature already owns the mechanism and GMI derives the candidate as a compile phase of D2 x D4/D5 rather than a kingdom
measurement_validity_status: valid: exact charged replay; answer signatures compared; one declared relation family per cell (a second relation seed is the obvious G2-style replication and is NOT run here); native prices are declared, not measured; the two columns bracket the store price but no column makes store access free
mechanism_attribution: the restriction maps are what make gluing polynomial: the backward pass is exactly the lookahead that the search parent lacks, which is why the search parent's serve is geometric only when failure is LATE in the cover and is cheaper than the candidate's when it is not. The table parent's d^n construction is the price of being denied composition across overlaps: without RESTRICT it can only enumerate the product space

original_hypothesis: the event-causal / partial-order carrier (a causal poset of events held as one vector clock per event, whose native law is the lattice JOIN of the predecessors' clocks) is NOT a new structural domain against the RELATIONAL parents: a D2 table-memory parent that materializes the transitive closure and a D4/D5 program-search parent that searches for a causal path both reproduce its answers exactly. Development presents the events one at a time in a DECLARED LINEAR EXTENSION; each cell is run under TWO declared linear extensions of the SAME poset (variant 0 = level-major, variant 1 = Kahn with LCG tie-break, seed 60), so interleaving invariance is measured, not assumed. OBLIGATION (the one the carrier is for): for every ordered pair of events decide happens-before / happens-after / CONCURRENT, invariantly under the observed interleaving. Rows: POSET (candidate: one w-component vector clock per event, JOIN on EXTEND, componentwise COMPARE on query), PAIRTABLE (matched parent 1, D2 table memory, DENIED the join operator so it stores the observed immediate-dependency edges and materializes the full n x n transitive closure by a charged Floyd-Warshall pass, then serves lookups), SEQ_MEM (matched parent 2, D2 sequence/exemplar memory: the observed interleaving as positions, answered by position order), PROG_SEARCH (matched parent 3, D4/D5 program search + verifier: the edge list plus a charged causal-path search at query time), POSET_NOJOIN (negative twin: the JOIN removed, so each clock carries only its own chain component and causality never crosses a cross-chain edge).
